description.value:
This waterskin coruscates with holy energy. After using any of the activations, the waterskin is empty, but slowly refills itself. It becomes full enough to use again at the next dawn.

Activate—Blessed Bombard 3 (concentrate, manipulate)

Requirements The anointed waterskin is full

Effect You throw the anointed waterskin up to 60 feet. The water explodes out of it, with the effects of a DC 25 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Holy Cascade] .

Activate—Divine Decanting 1 minute (manipulate)

Requirements The anointed waterskin is full

Effect You decant the water, creating up to 10 vials of holy water. You must provide the vials. Holy water created this clearly temporary upon inspection, and fades away after 8 hours.

Activate—Sacred Sip 1 (manipulate)

Requirements The anointed waterskin is full

Effect You drink the water within the waterskin, granting you the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Bless]. As normal, you can increase the spell's radius by Sustaining it.
